caption: The drawing is a black ink illustration on a beige background, depicting a section of a building interior with an ornate protective iron grille labeled "GARDE de FRISE" in the upper left corner. The composition features an arched iron grillwork fixed over a window or door; the grill has pointed, branch-like extensions at the top, radiating outward, and a central decorative swirl pattern. Below the arched grill, a straight section of the guard with vertical bars and a zigzag band at the bottom edge is attached to a railing. To the right, a door with panel detailing, a visible knob, and a slight open angle is illustrated, showing thickness and wood grain texture. A portion of the floor with wooden planks and partial walls is drawn at the base. Precise dimensions are noted on the drawing: the height of the door and guard assembly is 70 inches, the section beneath the grill is 35 inches tall, and the width of the composition is 47 inches. The drawing employs fine, consistent linework with occasional hatching for minimal shading.
title: Iron Balcony Garde
